start.line: You run a cigarette company. TV ads are about to be banned. Will you make less money—or more?
dialogue: You run a cigarette company. TV ads are about to be banned. Will you make less money—or more?

expect_hurt.line: Maybe. You could lose customers. But your rival is losing its TV ads too. Let’s see why that matters.
dialogue: Maybe. You could lose customers. But your rival is losing its TV ads too. Let’s see why that matters.
expect_hurt.help: Let’s use a small game. You’re blue. Your goal: keep more coins.

expect_help.line: Maybe. You’ll save on ads. But could you lose customers too? Let’s see what happens.
dialogue: Maybe. You’ll save on ads. But could you lose customers too? Let’s see what happens.
expect_help.help: Let’s use a small game. You’re blue. Your goal: keep more coins.

meet_rival.line: Here’s your rival. You sell the same thing. Right now, you both run ads—and each has five customers.
dialogue: Here’s your rival. You sell the same thing. Right now, you both run ads—and each has five customers.

baseline.line: Your customers pay you five coins. Your ad costs two. That leaves you three.
dialogue: Your customers pay you five coins. Your ad costs two. That leaves you three.
baseline.help: Each customer brings 1 coin. Running your ad costs 2 coins.
